lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) (C : ℝ),
  (∀ (v : E → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) v →
        HasCompactSupport v →
          ∫ (x : E), v x ^ 2 * Real.log (v x ^ 2) ∂μ - (∫ (x : E), v x ^ 2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ (x : E), v x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
            2 * C * ∫ (x : E), ‖gradient v x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) →
    ∀ (f : E → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 μ →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) μ →
              ∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) ∂μ - (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
                2 * C * ∫ (x : E), ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
approved_definition_context: In the differentiability order, the embedded infinite natural index denotes smoothness (all finite derivative orders), not analyticity.
